meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商视频营销创作技能，支持多品类商品的营销视频脚本生成，包含6阶段创作流程、智能体提示词框架、8种商品类型模板，适用于电商平台、社交媒体、品牌推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成电商营销视频脚本，覆盖多品类商品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商商品快速生成营销视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Generate ecommerce marketing video scripts for multiple product categories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create marketing video scripts for ecommerce products

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按6阶段流程创作电商营销视频脚本：先收集商品信息，再提炼痛点与卖点，按“痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决”结构写脚本，并给出镜头、运镜和后期建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为商品创作营销视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销专业指导时触发。

say.text: 帮我写个自动喂食器30秒视频脚本，目标人群是都市白领
say.note: 会按6阶段流程产出脚本和镜头建议

say.text: 给这款智能厨电做60秒科技感视频脚本，突出远程控制
我的护肤品卖点是保湿提亮，写15秒短视频脚本
say.note: 会生成痛点切入等结构的脚本

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will follow a 6-stage process to create e-commerce marketing video scripts: collect product info, define needs, understand product, write script using pain-point→demo→solution structure, and provide camera/movement and post-production suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a marketing video script for a product or requests professional guidance on e-commerce video marketing.

say_en.text: Write a 30s video script for an auto feeder, targeting urban white-collar workers.
say_en.note: Outputs script and camera suggestions via 6-stage process.

say_en.text: Create a 60s tech-style video script for this smart kitchen appliance, highlight remote control.
My skincare product's selling points are hydration and brightening; make a 15s short video script.
say_en.note: Generates script with pain-point opening and solution.
